intro: Grenada includes the main island and Carriacou and Petite Martinique.

chapters.title: Land
text: Volcanic mountains are covered in rainforest, with Grand Etang crater lake. Grand Anse is a long white beach. An underwater sculpture park lies off the west coast.

chapters.title: Hurricanes
text: Grenada lies at the southern edge of the hurricane belt but has been hit hard.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake in an old volcano.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Grenada's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
